videos.title: Godot 4 Roguelike Course – Build a Complete Top-Down Action Game
videos.author: freeCodeCamp.org
videos.description:
Build a complete top-down action roguelike in Godot 4, from an empty project to a game a stranger can open and play. About 10 hours, 8 chapters, 31 lessons. Most lessons stop for a Your Turn, where you build the next piece yourself before you see mine.
